passage:
On hot summer days, people in Maple City usually walk on the east side of Green Road. The reason is simple: there are more trees on that side.
A student group studied the street for a science project. They measured the temperature on both sides at noon for ten days. The side with more trees was usually three to five degrees cooler.
The students also asked shop owners about business. A drink shop on the tree side had more customers in the afternoon. The owner said people liked to stand in the shade while choosing drinks.
After reading the report, the city office decided to plant more trees on the west side of the road. The plan will take years, but the students are proud.
They learned that trees are not just beautiful. In a city, a tree can be an umbrella, an air conditioner, and a quiet helper.
